# Ensemble

A multiplayer, collaborative sandbox building game made with Godot 4, C#, and .NET. 

![](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/4cf9930a-357e-493c-acbf-bb64ed7a66af "Ensemble")

> [!NOTE]
> - This game is a direct successor to [Baja Builders](https://www.roblox.com/games/85484945236913) on Roblox.
> - Code quality may be "sub-par" (i.e. have imperfections) until enough time has passed to refine the code.
